values.display: doesn't make your connectivity to AWS more resilient
will not protect against a single device failure

claim: A LAG does not make connectivity to AWS more resilient. With more than one link and minimum links set to one, it protects against a single link failure, but not against a single device failure or device maintenance at AWS where the LAG terminates.
note: d12-044 Absorbed direct-connect-faq-lag-not-more-resilient (FAQ question: 'Does having a link aggregation group (LAG) make my connection more resilient?' (item 21).).
